# balena_application_tag (Data Source)

Reads the one application tag (the `application_tag` resource of the `/v7` API) that matches every configured attribute. At least one attribute must be set, and exactly one row must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "balena_application_tag" "example" {
  id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `application` (API field `application`). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the application tag. Selects the row when configured.
- `tag_key` (String) API field `tag_key` (short text). Between 1 and 100 characters. Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `value` (String) API field `value` (text). At most 1000 characters. Selects the row when configured.
